entities.summary: Vila Flor is a municipality in Portugal. Locally referred to as the Portuguese Capital of Olive Oil, Vila Flor is located in the Terra Quente Transmontana, in the southern part of the district of Bragança. The population in 2011 was 6,697, in an area of 265.81 square kilometres (102.63 mi2). Seixo de Manhoses was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
